items.descZh: 开发者历时一年打造了名为 Swift Chat 的 Swift 包，旨在精确复刻 iMessage 的经典交互体验。核心功能方面，该包最新引入了专为 AI 应用设计的助手模式，高度模仿了新版 Siri 的界面动态。亮点在于，用户提问的气泡会以优雅的动画效果升至屏幕顶部，而 AI 生成的回复则会以 Markdown 格式在下方实时流式传输。这种设计将原生 iOS 视觉风格与高效的 Markdown 解析完美结合，显著提升了对话的沉浸感与可读性。它非常适合需要快速构建具有高度定制化、原生视觉体验的 AI 聊天界面的开发场景。
items.quote: 与新版 Siri 应用完全一样，问题气泡以动画形式出现在屏幕顶部，然后智能体的回复以 Markdown 格式在下方流式呈现。

Write the flow once as Playwright steps with a line of narration on each; DemoForge drives the app, records it, zooms in on every click, draws a smooth cursor, speaks the narration and exports an MP4\. When the UI changes, run the same command again. [](/DixitRam/DemoForge/blob/phase1/demoforgedocs/demo.gif) Autozoom from the click log, not computer vision — the browser already knows where you clicked. Synthetic cursor with natural motion, since Playwright never moves a real one. Narration: local espeakng, or Gemini / ElevenLabs / Mistral with a key. The recorder holds each step until its line has been said. Editor in the browser: drag zooms, cut, captions, background, then export. A Chrome extension for recording by hand, feeding the same editor. Quick start Needs Node, pnpm and ffmpeg. espeakng (dnf install espeakng / apt install espeakng) gives you a free local voice; no API key needed. pnpm install pnpm C packages/core build pnpm exec playwrightcore install chromium node scripts/demoforge.mjs record demos/todomvc/flow.json drive the app, record node scripts/demoforge.mjs open demos/todomvc review in the editor node scripts/demoforge.mjs export demos/todomvc demos/todomvc/demo.mp4 demos/todomvc/flow.json records Playwright's public TodoMVC demo — copy it and point url at your own app. Layout packages/core @demoforge/core — types, zoom planner, evaluator, cursor path apps/editor Vite + React + Tailwind — player, timeline, compositor, export apps/extension MV3 Chrome extension — capture by hand + click log scripts/ demoforge.mjs — the record / open / export CLI pnpm r test runs the tests. demoforgedocs/ has the product vision and architecture notes. Voices Narration needs a voice provider; nothing else does, and the editor tells you which ones are available. espeakng (local) — free, offline, robotic. Gemini AI — copy .env.example to .env and put a key in GEMINI_API_KEY. The same key writes the script. Sounds like a person. .env at the repo root or in apps/editor/ both work; the key is read by the dev server only and never reaches the browser. A freetier key allows only a few requests a minute, so generating a long script pauses when the quota says to and picks up again — the button tells you how long it is waiting. ElevenLabs — ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, same two locations. The best voices. Metered per character: the free tier is 10,000 characters a month, personal use only, and asks you to credit ElevenLabs. items.author: dixit01
items.descZh: DemoForge 是一款开源的自动化产品演示视频生成工具，旨在解决传统手动录制、剪辑和配音产品演示视频效率低下的痛点，用户只需通过 Playwright 编写包含旁白的流程脚本即可驱动应用。其核心功能是自动执行脚本、录制屏幕操作，并利用浏览器原生点击日志实现精准的自动缩放，合成具有自然运动轨迹的虚拟光标，最终导出带语音旁白的 MP4 视频。工具内置了浏览器内编辑器，支持拖拽缩放、剪辑、字幕和背景自定义，配音集成了本地免费的 espeakng 以及 Gemini、ElevenLabs 等 AI 语音（如 ElevenLabs 提供每月 10,000 字符的免费额度）。此外，项目还提供了一款 Chrome 扩展程序，支持手动录制操作并同步至编辑器，兼顾了手动操作的灵活性。该项目目前处于 phase1 开发阶段（拥有 31 次提交和 7 个 Star），非常适合需要快速生成、频繁更新产品功能演示、在线教程及用户引导视频的开发团队和个人开发者。
items.quote: 根据脚本生成产品演示视频。将流程写成 Playwright 步骤，每步配一行旁白；DemoForge 驱动应用、录制视频，并放大细节。

items.title: Show HN: A Documentation Wayback Machine with Plakar
items.desc: A documentation Wayback Machine (powered by Plakar and Cloudflare R2) Timetravel any page: Every version is a [Plakar snapshot](https://www.plakar.io/docs/main/explanations/howplakarworks/). Pick a version chip to rebuild that page on demand. Retrieved live from an encrypted backup: Older versions are [decrypted and restored](https://www.plakar.io/docs/main/references/commands/plakarrestore/) at request time. Watch the real plakar commands and timings in the panel on the right. The whole site is captured: pages, images, PDFs, data files, and even the stylesheet all come from the [snapshot](https://www.plakar.io/docs/main/references/commands/plakarbackup/). Durable & offsite: The [encrypted store](https://www.plakar.io/docs/main/integrations/s3/) syncs to Cloudflare R2\. Snapshot the current docs or create a new version yourself from the panel on the right. Installing Nimbus Nimbus 2.0 runs your sync, your deploys, and now your edge functions from one CLI. Install it however you like: bash brew install nimbus macOS / Linux npm install g @nimbus/cli Node 18+ docker pull ghcr.io/nimbus/cli:2 container winget install Nimbus.CLI Windows SDKs track the CLI version: bash npm install @nimbus/sdk TypeScript pip install nimbussdk Python go get go.nimbus.dev/sdk Go Verify: bash nimbus version nimbus 2.0.0 Upgrading from 1.x? 2.0 changes a few config keys and the token model. Follow the [migration notes](../../guides/troubleshooting/) before you deploy. items.author: rishi_
items.descZh: 该文档系统基于 Plakar 和 Cloudflare R2 构建了一个支持时间旅行的 Wayback Machine，其核心是将每一次文档版本都封装为一个可独立还原的 Plakar 加密快照。用户可随时选取任意历史版本芯片，系统会在请求时从 R2 远程加密存储中实时解密并重建该页面，同时在右侧面板展示真实的 Plakar 命令与执行耗时，例如读取操作普遍在 1 毫秒内完成。系统完整捕获页面、图片、PDF 及样式表等所有静态资源，并利用内容寻址与 LZ4 压缩实现跨版本共享存储块，当前已保存 6 个版本，逻辑捕获量为 89 MB，磁盘存储仅占 39 MB。此方案特别适用于需要为文档站点提供不可篡改、可审计且支持任意历史版本回溯的团队或项目环境。
items.quote: 时间旅行任何页面：每个版本都是Plakar快照。

items.title: Show HN: Counterbranch – See how your PR changes access control
items.desc: Hi, we just released Counterbranch as a GitHub Action (alpha) and are looking for feedback. The action scans your codebase looking for unintended changes to authorization. This can happen in custom code, endpoints, guards, rbac, abac, policy-as-code files, etc. and can lead to broken access control
items.author: boorad
items.descZh: Counterbranch 作为一款 GitHub Action 测试版工具正式发布，旨在自动化扫描代码库中意外的授权变更，防止由此导致的访问控制失效。其核心功能在于能够深入检测自定义代码、API 端点、安全守卫、RBAC、ABAC 以及策略即代码（policy-as-code）等多种文件格式中的权限漂移。该工具的亮点在于其广泛的检测覆盖范围，能够在开发早期阶段捕捉到微小的、可能被人工忽视的权限配置变动，从而大幅提升代码安全性。它特别适用于采用 GitHub 工作流的 DevOps 团队，以及那些对访问控制精度要求极高的微服务或大规模分布式系统架构。通过将安全检查嵌入 CI/CD 流程，Counterbranch 能够帮助团队在部署前拦截潜在的安全漏洞。
items.quote: 该操作扫描您的代码库，查找对授权的意外更改。

items.title: Show HN: I built an application to work with multiple coding agents
items.desc: description: Use Claude Code and Codex in one app. Crowsnest is a private, local macOS workspace for multiple accounts, conversations, usage, handoffs, and agent crews. title: Crowsnest: all your Claude Code and Codex accounts. image: https://crowsnest.app/preview.png [Skip to content](main) All your Claude Code and Codex accounts. One place. The Crowsnest app is a private, local macOS workspace. Compare providerreported usage across accounts, choose where new work starts, and continue on another when one reaches its limit — with a compact briefing and visible lineage. [ Download for macOS ](/download/) [See multiple accounts](accounts) Crowsnest Start new conversation Library Conversations Insights Browse All conversations84 Projects84 checkoutweb23 ordersapi19 AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md skills3 authservice14 billingservice11 Usage quota Claude Code Defaultpro Session0% Week33% Work Session0% Week14% Codexplus Week36% just now Demo UserPro · local Codex · gpt5.6sol 18K / 258K 7% Week 36% Run parallel What will you ship? Describe the task. In Crowsnest, it becomes a real Claude Code or Codex session—ready to resume, edit, or branch. Message for the Crowsnest demo ordersapi Codex Bypass all High GPT5.6Sol Start This preview uses a prepared response and sends nothing. Try the launchtochat flow: enter any prompt and the preview will show a prepared response. Your text stays in this page—nothing is sent or saved. Multiple accounts Hit a limit on one account. Keep going on another. When a session runs out of provider quota, Crowsnest offers to continue on a second subscription account you are already signed into. It quotes a compact briefing into a fresh session under that account and keeps the lineage back to the original — an attributed fork, never a disguised native resume. Claude Code and Codex alike; each account keeps its own config directory. Fresh installs ask first; optional automatic continuation acts only with one unambiguous destination. Optin routing uses readable allowance evidence; a missing reading never masquerades as zero. [See how multipleaccount continuation works →](/blogs/claudecodecodexmultipleaccounts/) [How to use multiple Claude Code accounts, by hand or in Crowsnest →](/guides/usemultipleclaudecodeaccounts/) [How to use multiple Codex accounts, by hand or in Crowsnest →](/guides/usemultiplecodexaccounts/) [Claude Code usage limit reached? Every option, in order →](/guides/claudecodeusagelimitreached/) Your browser cannot play this video. [Open the Accounts demo video](media/introaccounts.mp4?v=20260902). The Accounts panel showing peraccount provider logins, usage trend and remaining allowance, a second named account added and made default, and the policy that decides what happens when one account runs out. Click the video or press Enter or Space to pause or play it. Agent Crew Agent Crew turns one objective into a reviewed multiagent plan. Ask a readonly lead agent to turn an objective into an editable dependency graph. Review provider choice, prompts, file claims, and worktree paths _before_ anything runs — it is a reviewed workflow, not a black box. Research, synthesis, implementation, integration, and crossreview. Steer, stop, retry, or reroute individual tasks as work proceeds. No run reports Done without completed integration and crossreview. [Read the reviewed Agent Crew workflow →](/blogs/agentcrewworkflow/) Your browser cannot play this video. [Open the Crew demo video](media/crewdemo.mp4?v=20260902). Crew turning an objective into a reviewed multiagent plan and starting the approved run. Click the video or press Enter or Space to pause or play it. Remote Workspaces Your agents do not have to live on this Mac. Connect a machine you already reach over SSH and its Claude Code and Codex work joins the same workspace. Crowsnest sends a checksumverified copy of its own helper down that connection, so there is _nothing to install_ on the server. One noninteractive SSH stream — no port forwarding, remote shell, or installer. Remote conversations stay on the remote machine; nothing is copied here. Remote projects and accounts join the ordinary launcher, tagged by location. [How the SSH boundary works →](/blogs/claudecodecodexremoteserverssh/) Local and remote locations in one Crowsnest workspace The folder picker lists This Mac above a connected server tagged Remote, each with its own projects. A single noninteractive SSH stream links Crowsnest on the Mac to a checksumverified helper on the server, which runs Claude Code and Codex there. LOCATIONS This Mac \~/work/api \~/work/web \~/work/landing buildserver REMOTE \~/srv/pipeline \~/srv/models \~/srv/ingest Claude Code and Codex, discovered on the server one ssh T stream Verified helper SHA256 checked Agent processes Remote transcripts Provider accounts YOUR SERVER no forwarding · no shell no installer · no daemon UI Studio Point at the interface. Hand the change to an agent. Open a live preview of an enabled project, select an element, and make reversible visual drafts — text, spacing, radius, size. Crowsnest turns the selection and your draft into a providerneutral component brief and sends it to Claude Code, Codex, or both. An accessible selection breadcrumb with bounded DOM and style context. Drafts are reversible — nothing is written until an agent writes it. Compare both providers against the same brief on the parallel board. items.author: teivz
items.descZh: Crowsnest 是一款专为 macOS 设计的本地私有工作空间，旨在将多个 Claude Code 和 Codex 账户、对话、用量及代理团队整合到单一应用中。其核心功能包括跨账户的用量对比与无缝续接，当某个账户达到配额限制时，系统会自动提供简报将会话延续至另一个已登录的订阅账户，并保留清晰的谱系追踪。用户可直观对比不同账户的实时用量（如查看 Claude Code 周用量 33% 或 Codex 会话中 18K / 258K tokens 占比 7% 等具体指标），并支持按天、模型、项目等维度深入分析 7 天至 365 天的本地历史用量。此外，“Agent Crew”功能可将目标转化为经过审查的多智能体计划，而远程工作空间则通过单条 SSH 流和校验过的 helper 实现零安装的远程服务器协作。UI Studio 允许用户直接在界面上选择元素并生成可逆的视觉草案交由 Agent 执行，适用于需要多账号统筹、复杂多智能体协同以及跨本地与远程开发环境的重度 AI 编程与设计场景。
items.quote: Crowsnest是一个私人的本地macOS工作区，可用于多个帐户，对话，使用，会话和代理人员。
